name: media-source-ownership
prompt: Fix the existing MediaSourceOwner adapter without changing its public API or adding packages. Its fake player backend supports overlapping asynchronous source opens and returns a distinct owned handle per successful open. Only the newest still-requested source may become current. Release replaced or stale successful handles exactly once, invalidate pending opens when stopped/disposed, reject new starts after disposal, and keep a working current source if its replacement fails. A failed close must not leave its handle current for a repeated stop to close again. This is a controlled playback-adapter test, not permission to operate camera/microphone, connect to a live room, or claim native playback verification.
